svg.title: Euro double-nymph — leader diagram
svg.desc: Leader schematic for Euro double-nymph: 12 ft · 20 lb Level mono butt, then 1 ft · 12 lb Sighter — hi-vis, then 1 ft · 10 lb Sighter — contrast, then 5 ft · 5X · 5 lb Tippet.
svg.text: The heavy fly. It sets the
Dropper: 18–24 in above the point, on a tag or ring.
When: Riffles, seams and pocket water where you can hold a tight
line within a rod-and-a-half of the fish.
Not to scale — lengths are on the labels.
